Q1_achievable_recall_from_high_confidenc.high_confidence_restriction_is_near_vacu: L=1 seeds 99,276 -> L=8 seeds 97,197 (-2.1%). filter_short_track_components already deletes every component below min_len_effective=7, so the published 49.60% bidirectional-w8 figure IS ALREADY a high-confidence-seeded figure. 6bba bi_w8 49.60% (L1) -> 47.34% (L8).
Q1_achievable_recall_from_high_confidenc.oracle_is_not_achievable: The published table counts a never-detected node as reachable if ANY detected GT neighbour exists within w hops. The PROCEDURE additionally requires that neighbour's predicted node to be a FREE TRACK END (out-degree 0 forward / in-degree 0 backward). Measured at hop 1 on 6bba: oracle 2,499, but only 1,298 (51.9%) have a free-end seed, and 1,153 of those (88.8%) land within 7 um. Achievable/oracle = 46.1% on 6bba, 35.9% on 44b6, 44.5% pooled.
Q1_achievable_recall_from_high_confidenc.deeper_windows_lower_precision: 6bba oracle marginal per hop: 2499 / 1344 / 838 / 607 / 436 / 337 / 263 / 216. Burden grows ~linearly with window depth (a false chain never terminates) while true yield decays; precision at step 2 is ~0.38% against step 1's 0.71%.

Q2_false_candidate_burden.the_decisive_row: On the GT-ORACLE-VISIBLE surface -- only termini that an oracle says match an annotated GT node WITH a live GT continuation -- precision is 26.19% on 6bba (1,153 / 4,402) and 26.42% pooled, BELOW the exactly-derived break-even of 39.83% / 40.35%. Exact pooled delta -0.0074579 (6bba) / -0.0075052 (pooled). The mechanism fails even with a perfect oracle telling it where to look.
Q2_false_candidate_burden.why: 74% of annotated free ends with a live GT continuation had that continuation DETECTED -- the pipeline dropped the EDGE, not the node. The correct action there is a link, not a new node. That population is WS-A arm B's, already harvested for +0.0088059.

metric_free_FP_variant_QUARANTINED.why_quarantined: It is positive ONLY because 98.2% of the candidates sit off annotation and the edge term cannot see them -- the same annotation-coverage exploit the project pinned pi_vis=1.0 to prevent, and a pure count-multiplier effect (cf. node budget, 116% multiplier). It also assumes ZERO bipartite theft. Break-even theft rate over the 7,697 near-detected candidates is theta* = 2.22% (pooled) / 2.25% (6bba); at theta=0.10 the arm is -0.0129 pooled and at theta=0.25 it is -0.0373. Not a promotable number.

Q4_matched_controls_through_the_identica.design: Same generator, same kNN16 flow, same 7 um host rule; termini partitioned ONLY by what GT says lies beyond them.
Q4_matched_controls_through_the_identica.conclusion: Propagation accuracy is NOT the binding constraint and is statistically indistinguishable between the target and the control (3.68 vs 3.77 um median, 89.8% vs 87.1% within 7 um). The idea's motion model works. What fails is the denominator.

vs_DAXI_temporal_accumulation.distinction_is_REAL: DAXI accumulation integrated DETECTOR RESPONSE along motion paths and required sub-threshold image evidence; its isolated gate seeded from DE-NOVO low-threshold peaks (41k-87k peaks/frame, ~40x the real cell count) and its moonshot pilot propagated around an ORACLE GT-lineage tube. This proposal asserts a node from LINEAGE CONTINUITY with a GT-FREE kNN16 flow, seeded only from existing tracks, and needs no detector response at all.
vs_DAXI_temporal_accumulation.and_it_IS_better: DAXI isolated gate oracle: 6bba 5/57 misses recovered (8.8%) for 3,280 added nodes = 656 nodes per recovery. This proposal: 1,153/13,813 (8.35%) for 162,001 candidates = 140.5 per recovery -- 4.7x more efficient.
vs_DAXI_temporal_accumulation.and_it_still_fails: 56x short of break-even on 6bba, and -0.0075 even on the GT-oracle-visible surface.

vs_de_novo_peak_detection_detector_diver.distinction_is_REAL_AND_MEASURED: Detector diversity was strictly nested (0 new nodes; union of five gained +0/+1 GT nodes). This mechanism recovers 1,153 6bba never-detected GT nodes at positions no detector threshold produces, because the position comes from flow propagation rather than from a peak. The distinction is measured, not argued.

vs_WHAT_IS_ALREADY_DEPLOYED_the_finding_.claim: The window-1 form of this proposal IS ALREADY LIVE. src/biotrack/wrapper.py::close_single_frame_gaps pairs a track END at t with a track START at t+2, requires SPATIAL AGREEMENT (raw distance <= GAP_CLOSE_UM*(gap+1) = 12.0 um, density-adaptive), and inserts a propagated node at t+1. OUTPUT_GAP_CLOSE defaults ON; GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP is pinned to 1 by effective_gap_max = min(GAP_CLOSE_MAX_GAP, 1).
vs_WHAT_IS_ALREADY_DEPLOYED_the_finding_.scale_already_spent: 169,509 synthetic gap-close nodes inserted corpus-wide (3.31% of the 5,118,041 final nodes): 44b6 95,208, 6bba 74,301, from 323,231 gap candidates (52.4% selection rate). gap_reused_existing 0. The 14,708 never-detected pool is what REMAINS AFTER that operator ran.
vs_WHAT_IS_ALREADY_DEPLOYED_the_finding_.the_candidate_surface_is_its_residue: Residual end(t)/start(t+2) closest-pair distance has per-crop median 21.34 um and only 5.97% of frames retain any pair within the deployed 12 um threshold -- the operator has already consumed everything inside its own gate. Direct measurement of the proposal's own bidirectional-agreement criterion on the residue: pooled 1,778 agreeing pairs at R=7 um for 8 hits.

follow_on_levers_ALSO_FALSIFIED.arm_B_style_re_aim_of_the_gap_close_gate: Gating on the kNN16 flow-compensated end-start residual at the SAME 12 um radius instead of the raw distance improves precision in the right direction on both families -- pooled 0.287% -> 0.390% (1.36x), 6bba 0.712% -> 0.829% (1.16x) -- exactly arm B's signature. But the absolute level is two orders of magnitude below break-even, so the arm is still -0.0475392 pooled. The re-aim is REAL and INSUFFICIENT here.

gate_decision: FAIL. The +0.005 gate needs 60.68% precision on 6bba against a measured 0.71% (85.3x) and against 26.19% (1.5x) even on a GT-oracle-visible surface. The oracle ceiling is large (+0.0594 6bba at window 8) so the idea is not dead on reachability -- it is dead on selection, and the required enrichment is not reachable by any measured channel in this project's inventory. CLOSE.
